name: theme
description: Ink-on-paper theme contract: near-black ink, white paper, muted gray text. MaterialTheme plus spacing, motion, and elevation.
avoidWhen: Do not fork a second color or type system beside MaterialTheme. Do not introduce a colorful brand or a green identity.
aiHints: Read color, type, and shape from MaterialTheme.colorScheme / typography / shapes
Read spacing, motion, and elevation from AppTheme
primary is ink (the dark pill); do not remap it to a colorful accent
tertiary is the reserved signal (progress, location); do not use it for primary actions
Do not import Light* or Dark* color tokens; they are not a public color API
Do not nest a second MaterialTheme inside AppTheme
Bump THEME_VERSION when adding a spacing, motion, or elevation token
